query: Retrieve page details, including page category, fan count, talking about count, and were here count, for all pages
Retrieve post records from the post_history data, including each post’s associated page identifier
Retrieve lifetime_post_metrics_total data for each post, including post clicks and paid impressions

Filter posts to include only those where the page category is available in the page data and post clicks are available in the lifetime_post_metrics_total data, and then join posts to their associated page details and post metrics
ads.sql:
WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT 
    page.category,
    page.fan_count,
    page.talking_about_count,
    page.were_here_count,
    lifetime_post_metrics_total.post_clicks,
    lifetime_post_metrics_total.post_impressions_paid
  FROM post_history
  LEFT JOIN page ON post_history.page_id = page.id
  LEFT JOIN lifetime_post_metrics_total ON post_history.id = lifetime_post_metrics_total.post_id
  WHERE page.category IS NOT NULL
    AND lifetime_post_metrics_total.post_clicks IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT *
FROM base_data

query: Retrieve ad group-level clicks from ad_group_level_report using ad_group_id and date, along with cost, impressions, and campaign_bidding_strategy
Retrieve campaign serving_status and other campaign attributes from campaign_history using campaign id
Retrieve account_name and related account details from profile using account_id or customer_id
Retrieve portfolio context (budget_amount, budget_policy, budget_start_date, budget_end_date, last_updated_date) from portfolio_history using portfolio id if available
Retrieve ad group to campaign mappings from ad_group_history using ad_group id and campaign_id
Determine campaign counts and total clicks by joining ad_group_level_report, ad_group_history, campaign_history, profile, and portfolio_history, then group by campaign serving_status and account_name
ads.sql:
WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT 
    campaign_history.name,
    campaign_history.serving_status,
    portfolio_history.name,
    portfolio_history.budget_amount,
    profile.account_name,
    ad_group_level_report.cost,
    ad_group_level_report.clicks
  FROM campaign_history
  LEFT JOIN portfolio_history ON campaign_history.portfolio_id = portfolio_history.id
  LEFT JOIN profile ON campaign_history.profile_id = profile.id
  LEFT JOIN ad_group_history ON campaign_history.id = ad_group_history.campaign_id
  LEFT JOIN ad_group_level_report ON ad_group_history.id = ad_group_level_report.ad_group_id
  WHERE campaign_history.name IS NOT NULL
    AND ad_group_level_report.cost IS NOT NULL
    AND ad_group_level_report.clicks IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  serving_status,
  account_name,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(CAST(clicks AS INTEGER)) as total
FROM base_data
GROUP BY serving_status, account_name

query: Retrieve ad group-level metrics (ad_group_id, date, clicks, cost, impressions, campaign_bidding_strategy) from ad_group_level_report
Retrieve ad group to campaign mappings (id, campaign_id) from ad_group_history to link ad groups to campaigns
Retrieve campaign attributes (id, serving_status, customer_id) from campaign_history to obtain Campaign Serving Status and link to accounts
Retrieve account information (id, account_name) from profile to obtain Account Name for each account
Retrieve portfolio attributes (id, budget_amount, budget_policy, budget_start_date, budget_end_date, last_updated_date) from portfolio_history for portfolio context

Join ad_group_level_report with ad_group_history, campaign_history, and profile (and optionally portfolio_history if applicable) to compute total clicks and record counts grouped by Campaign Serving Status and Account Name
ads.sql:
WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT 
    campaign_history.name,
    campaign_history.serving_status,
    portfolio_history.name,
    portfolio_history.budget_amount,
    profile.account_name,
    ad_group_level_report.cost,
    ad_group_level_report.clicks
  FROM campaign_history
  LEFT JOIN portfolio_history ON campaign_history.portfolio_id = portfolio_history.id
  LEFT JOIN profile ON campaign_history.profile_id = profile.id
  LEFT JOIN ad_group_history ON campaign_history.id = ad_group_history.campaign_id
  LEFT JOIN ad_group_level_report ON ad_group_history.id = ad_group_level_report.ad_group_id
  WHERE campaign_history.name IS NOT NULL
    AND ad_group_level_report.cost IS NOT NULL
    AND ad_group_level_report.clicks IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  serving_status,
  account_name,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(CAST(clicks AS INTEGER)) as total
FROM base_data
GROUP BY serving_status, account_name

query: Retrieve campaign-level metrics from campaign_level_report, including campaign_id, date, clicks, campaign_budget_amount, campaign_budget_currency_code, campaign_bidding_strategy, and campaign_applicable_budget_rule_id for all campaigns
Retrieve campaign state information (status and serving_status) for each campaign from campaign_history using campaign_history.id matched to campaign_level_report.campaign_id
Retrieve portfolio details, including portfolio name and budget_amount, from portfolio_history and determine how portfolios are associated with campaigns
Retrieve account context (account_id, account_name, account_type, account_marketplace_string_id, country_code) from profile for the relevant campaigns and/or portfolios

Combine campaign_level_report with campaign_history, portfolio_history, and profile to produce records that contain clicks, campaign budget amounts, campaign state, and portfolio name for each campaign

Group the combined records by campaign state and portfolio name, and for each group calculate the number of records and the total clicks, while also listing the individual click counts and budget amounts within each group
ads.sql:
WITH clean_data AS (
  SELECT 
    campaign_history.state,
    campaign_level_report.clicks,
    portfolio_history.name,
    portfolio_history.budget_amount,
    profile.daily_budget,
    COALESCE(CAST(campaign_level_report.clicks AS INTEGER), 0) as clicks_clean,
    COALESCE(CAST(portfolio_history.budget_amount AS DOUBLE), 0.0) as budget_amount_clean
  FROM campaign_history
  LEFT JOIN campaign_level_report ON campaign_history.id = campaign_level_report.campaign_id
  LEFT JOIN portfolio_history ON campaign_history.portfolio_id = portfolio_history.id
  LEFT JOIN profile ON campaign_history.profile_id = profile.id
  WHERE campaign_history.state IS NOT NULL
    AND campaign_level_report.clicks IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  state,
  name,
  clicks_clean,
  budget_amount_clean,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(clicks_clean) as total
FROM clean_data
GROUP BY state, name, clicks_clean, budget_amount_clean

query: Retrieve campaign-level metrics (campaign_id, date, clicks, cost, campaign_budget_type) from campaign_level_report

Retrieve campaign information (id, name, status, serving_status, customer_id, advertising_channel_type, start_date, end_date) from campaign_history for the campaigns referenced in campaign_level_report

Retrieve account information, including account_name (id, account_id, account_name, account_type, account_marketplace_string_id, account_sub_type, country_code) from profile for the accounts linked to campaigns in campaign_history
Join campaign_level_report with campaign_history on campaign_id = id to associate metrics with campaigns
Join the resulting campaign data with profile on customer_id = account_id (or appropriate key) to associate campaigns with account_name
Using the joined data, group records by account_name and campaign_budget_type and compute clicks, cost, count of records, and total clicks across all campaigns for each unique combination
ads.sql:
WITH clean_data AS (
  SELECT 
    campaign_history.name,
    campaign_level_report.date,
    campaign_level_report.clicks,
    campaign_level_report.cost,
    campaign_level_report.campaign_budget_type,
    profile.account_name,
    COALESCE(CAST(campaign_level_report.clicks AS INTEGER), 0) as clicks_clean,
    COALESCE(CAST(REPLACE(CAST(campaign_level_report.cost AS VARCHAR), ',', '') AS DOUBLE), 0.0) as cost_clean
  FROM campaign_history
  LEFT JOIN campaign_level_report ON campaign_history.id = campaign_level_report.campaign_id
  LEFT JOIN profile ON campaign_history.profile_id = profile.id
  WHERE campaign_history.name IS NOT NULL
    AND campaign_level_report.clicks IS NOT NULL
    AND campaign_level_report.cost IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  account_name,
  campaign_budget_type,
  clicks_clean,
  cost_clean,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(clicks_clean) as total
FROM clean_data
GROUP BY account_name, campaign_budget_type, clicks_clean, cost_clean

query: Retrieve hourly ad-level spend metrics from ad_hourly_report using fields ad_id, date, spend, impressions, swipes, conversion_purchases_value, conversion_add_billing, and conversion_add_cart
Map each ad in ad_hourly_report to its corresponding ad_squad_id and creative_id using ad_history, and retrieve the ad name, type, status, updated_at, display_url, and final_urls
Look up the Ad Squad name and campaign_id for each ad_squad_id using ad_squad_history

Retrieve campaign context (name, status, serving_status, customer_id, advertising_channel_type, start_date, end_date) for each campaign_id from campaign_history without changing the final grouping dimensions

Map each creative_id to its ad_account_id and related creative attributes (creative_name, url, base_url, url_host, url_path, utm_source, utm_medium, source_relation) using snapchat_ads__creative_history_prep
Look up the Account name for each ad_account_id via ad_account_history where ad_account_history.id = ad_account_id
For each Ad Squad name and Account name pair, aggregate hourly spend records to compute the list of individual spend values, the number of records, and the total spend
ads.sql:
WITH clean_data AS (
  SELECT 
    issue_merged.merged_at,
    requested_reviewer_history.requested_id,
    requested_reviewer_history.actor_id,
    issue.state,
    issue.locked,
    pull_request_review.body,
    COALESCE(issue_merged.merged_at, '1900-01-01 00:00:00') as merged_at_clean,
    COALESCE(pull_request_review.body, '') as body_clean
  FROM pull_request
  LEFT JOIN issue_merged ON pull_request.issue_id = issue_merged.issue_id
  LEFT JOIN requested_reviewer_history ON pull_request.id = requested_reviewer_history.pull_request_id
  LEFT JOIN issue ON pull_request.issue_id = issue.id
  LEFT JOIN pull_request_review ON pull_request.id = pull_request_review.pull_request_id
  WHERE issue.state IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  state,
  locked,
  merged_at_clean,
  body_clean,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN merged_at_clean != '1900-01-01 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total
FROM clean_data
GROUP BY state, locked, merged_at_clean, body_clean

query: From ad_hourly_report, retrieve hourly ad-level metrics including ad_id, date, spend, conversion_purchases_value, impressions, swipes, conversion_add_billing, and conversion_add_cart, and calculate cleaned spend amount and conversion purchases per ad_id and date.

From ad_history, map each ad_id to its corresponding ad_squad_id and confirm the relationship between ads and ad squads using fields (id as ad_id, ad_squad_id, creative_id, name, type, status, updated_at, display_url, final_urls).
From ad_squad_history, retrieve ad squad details (id, campaign_id, name) and use them to get the ad_squad_name and campaign_id for each ad_squad_id.
From ad_account_history, retrieve account details (id, name) and map each ad_account_id to its corresponding account name.

From campaign_history, retrieve campaign context (id, name, status, serving_status, customer_id, advertising_channel_type, start_date, end_date) and link it to each ad squad via campaign_id for additional campaign-level attributes.

Combine the linked data from ad_hourly_report, ad_history, ad_squad_history, ad_account_history, and campaign_history to summarize, for each unique combination of ad squad name, account name, cleaned spend amount, and conversion purchases, the number of records and the total spend.
ads.sql:
WITH clean_data AS (
  SELECT 
    ad_squad_history.name,
    ad_hourly_report.spend,
    ad_hourly_report.conversion_purchases,
    ad_account_history.name as account_name,
    COALESCE(CAST(REPLACE(CAST(ad_hourly_report.spend AS VARCHAR), ',', '') AS DOUBLE), 0.0) as spend_clean,
    COALESCE(CAST(ad_hourly_report.conversion_purchases AS INTEGER), 0) as conversion_purchases_clean
  FROM ad_squad_history
  LEFT JOIN ad_history ON ad_squad_history.id = ad_history.ad_squad_id
  LEFT JOIN ad_hourly_report ON ad_history.id = ad_hourly_report.ad_id
  LEFT JOIN campaign_history ON ad_squad_history.campaign_id = campaign_history.id
  LEFT JOIN ad_account_history ON campaign_history.ad_account_id = ad_account_history.id
  WHERE ad_squad_history.name IS NOT NULL
    AND ad_hourly_report.spend IS NOT NULL
    AND ad_hourly_report.conversion_purchases IS NOT NULL
    AND ad_account_history.name IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  name,
  account_name,
  spend_clean,
  conversion_purchases_clean,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(spend_clean) as total
FROM clean_data
GROUP BY name, account_name, spend_clean, conversion_purchases_clean

query: Retrieve hourly campaign-level spend and swipes from campaign_hourly_report keyed by campaign_id and date
Retrieve customer_id from campaign_history by joining campaign_history.id to campaign_hourly_report.campaign_id
Retrieve ad account names from ad_account_history using customer_id mapped to ad_account_history.id
Join campaign_hourly_report, campaign_history, and ad_account_history to associate spend and swipes with ad account names
Group records by ad account name and the cleaned spend and swipes values, and compute the count of records and total spend for each group
ads.sql:
WITH clean_data AS (
  SELECT 
    ad_account_history.name,
    campaign_hourly_report.spend,
    campaign_hourly_report.swipes,
    campaign_hourly_report.video_views,
    COALESCE(CAST(REPLACE(CAST(campaign_hourly_report.spend AS VARCHAR), ',', '') AS DOUBLE), 0.0) as spend_clean,

query: Retrieve search term and keyword-level metrics from search_term_keyword_stats, including ad_group_id, campaign_id, clicks, date, customer_id, conversions, conversions_value, and cost_micros
Look up each ad_group_id from search_term_keyword_stats in ad_group_history to obtain the corresponding ad group type and ad group name
Look up each campaign_id from search_term_keyword_stats in campaign_history to obtain the corresponding campaign serving status
For each customer_id associated with campaigns in campaign_history, look up the matching account_history.id to obtain the account manager
Aggregate the joined data to compute total clicks grouped by ad group type, ad group name, campaign serving status, and account manager
Aggregate the joined data to compute the number of records grouped by ad group type, ad group name, campaign serving status, and account manager
ads.sql:
WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT 
    search_term_keyword_stats.clicks,
    search_term_keyword_stats.conversions,
    ad_group_history.type,
    ad_group_history.name,
    campaign_history.serving_status,
    account_history.manager
  FROM search_term_keyword_stats
  LEFT JOIN ad_group_history ON search_term_keyword_stats.ad_group_id = ad_group_history.id
  LEFT JOIN campaign_history ON search_term_keyword_stats.campaign_id = campaign_history.id
  LEFT JOIN account_history ON search_term_keyword_stats.customer_id = account_history.id
  WHERE search_term_keyword_stats.clicks IS NOT NULL
    AND search_term_keyword_stats.conversions IS NOT NULL
    AND ad_group_history.type IS NOT NULL
    AND ad_group_history.name IS NOT NULL
    AND campaign_history.serving_status IS NOT NULL
    AND account_history.manager IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  type,
  name,
  serving_status,
  manager,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(CAST(clicks AS INTEGER)) as total
FROM base_data
GROUP BY type, name, serving_status, manager

query: Retrieve conversion and impression values per campaign from campaign_stats using customer_id and date
Retrieve serving_status and advertising_channel_type for each campaign from campaign_history using campaign id and customer_id
Retrieve account manager for each account from account_history using id mapped from campaign_history.customer_id
Join campaign_stats with campaign_history on campaign identifiers and customer_id to associate stats with serving_status and advertising_channel_type
Join the combined campaign data with account_history on campaign_history.customer_id = account_history.id to associate each campaign with an account manager
Group the joined data by serving_status, advertising_channel_type, and account manager, and compute conversion values, impression values, record counts, and total conversions for each group
ads.sql:
WITH clean_data AS (
  SELECT 
    campaign_history.serving_status,
    campaign_history.advertising_channel_type,
    campaign_stats.conversions,
    campaign_stats.impressions,
    account_history.manager,
    COALESCE(CAST(campaign_stats.conversions AS DOUBLE), 0.0) as conversions_clean,
    COALESCE(CAST(campaign_stats.impressions AS INTEGER), 0) as impressions_clean
  FROM campaign_history
  LEFT JOIN campaign_stats ON campaign_history.id = campaign_stats.id
  LEFT JOIN account_history ON campaign_history.customer_id = account_history.id
  WHERE campaign_history.serving_status IS NOT NULL
    AND campaign_history.advertising_channel_type IS NOT NULL
    AND campaign_stats.conversions IS NOT NULL
    AND campaign_stats.impressions IS NOT NULL
    AND account_history.manager IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  serving_status,
  advertising_channel_type,
  manager,
  conversions_clean,
  impressions_clean,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(conversions_clean) as total
FROM clean_data
GROUP BY serving_status, advertising_channel_type, manager, conversions_clean, impressions_clean

query: Retrieve keyword-level metrics including ad_group_base_ad_group, date, clicks, and customer_id from keyword_stats
Retrieve ad group attributes including id, name, and type from ad_group_history
Join keyword_stats and ad_group_history where keyword_stats.ad_group_base_ad_group = ad_group_history.id to associate each keyword record with its ad group name and type
From the joined data, group records by ad group name and ad group type and calculate total clicks and the count of keyword records for each group
ads.sql:
WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT 
    keyword_stats.clicks,
    keyword_stats.interactions,
    ad_group_history.name,
    ad_group_history.type
  FROM keyword_stats
  LEFT JOIN ad_group_history ON keyword_stats.ad_group_id = ad_group_history.id
  WHERE keyword_stats.clicks IS NOT NULL
    AND keyword_stats.interactions IS NOT NULL
    AND ad_group_history.name IS NOT NULL
    AND ad_group_history.type IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  name,
  type,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(CAST(clicks AS INTEGER)) as total
FROM base_data
GROUP BY name, type

query: Using the media_history, media_insights, and user_history data, can you show me all the posts with their complete engagement metrics? I need to see whether each post is a story, if comments are enabled, the like and comment counts from media_insights, and the user's follower count, following count, and total media count from user_history. Please only include records where all these fields have valid data.
ads.sql:
WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT 
    media_history.is_story,
    media_history.is_comment_enabled,
    media_insights.like_count,
    media_insights.comment_count,
    user_history.followers_count,
    user_history.follows_count,
    user_history.media_count
  FROM media_history
  LEFT JOIN media_insights ON media_history.id = media_insights.id
  LEFT JOIN user_history ON media_history.user_id = user_history.id
  WHERE media_history.is_story IS NOT NULL
    AND media_history.is_comment_enabled IS NOT NULL
    AND media_insights.like_count IS NOT NULL
    AND media_insights.comment_count IS NOT NULL
    AND user_history.followers_count IS NOT NULL
    AND user_history.follows_count IS NOT NULL
    AND user_history.media_count IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT *
FROM base_data

query: Using keyword_performance_daily_report, ad_history, keyword_history, ad_group_history, campaign_history, and account_history, please show keyword record counts and total clicks grouped by device type and keyword status: get device_type, clicks, and keyword_id from keyword_performance_daily_report (date, account_id, campaign_id, ad_group_id, ad_id, keyword_id, device_type, clicks, currency_code, device_os, network) which contains keyword-level performance metrics; use keyword_history (id, name, status, ad_group_id, match_type, modified_time, modification_time, bid_amount, bid_currency, campaign_id) to get the keyword status for each keyword_id; use ad_history (id, name, ad_group_id, status, display_url, updated_at, type, final_urls, ad_squad_id, creative_id) to get the ad titles (ad name) for each ad_id; use ad_group_history (id, name, type, campaign_id, status, updated_at, campaign_name, modified_time, start_date, end_date) as the ad group history lookup table to get the ad group names for each ad_group_id; use campaign_history (id, name, customer_id, serving_status, status, start_date, end_date, updated_at, advertising_channel_type, advertising_channel_subtype) to get campaign information and link to account where the customer_id from campaign_history corresponds to the account id in account_history; and use account_history (id, name, manager, descriptive_name, updated_at, auto_tagging_enabled, currency_code, final_url_suffix, hidden, manager_customer_id) as the account history lookup table to get the account names. Then group by device type and keyword status, and for each unique combination show the count of keyword records and total clicks, including the associated ad titles, ad group names, and account names.
ads.sql:
WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT 
    keyword_performance_daily_report.clicks,
    keyword_performance_daily_report.spend,
    keyword_performance_daily_report.device_type,
    keyword_history.status,
    ad_history.title,
    ad_group_history.name,
    campaign_history.budget,
    campaign_history.account_id,
    account_history.name
  FROM keyword_performance_daily_report
  LEFT JOIN keyword_history ON keyword_performance_daily_report.keyword_id = keyword_history.id
  LEFT JOIN ad_history ON keyword_performance_daily_report.ad_id = ad_history.id
  LEFT JOIN ad_group_history ON keyword_performance_daily_report.ad_group_id = ad_group_history.id
  LEFT JOIN campaign_history ON keyword_performance_daily_report.campaign_id = campaign_history.id
  LEFT JOIN account_history ON keyword_performance_daily_report.account_id = account_history.id
  WHERE keyword_performance_daily_report.clicks IS NOT NULL
    AND keyword_performance_daily_report.spend IS NOT NULL
    AND keyword_performance_daily_report.device_type IS NOT NULL
    AND keyword_history.status IS NOT NULL
    AND ad_history.title IS NOT NULL
    AND ad_group_history.name IS NOT NULL
    AND campaign_history.budget IS NOT NULL
    AND account_history.name IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  device_type,
  status,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(CAST(clicks AS INTEGER)) as total
FROM base_data
GROUP BY device_type, status

query: Retrieve impressions, language, and related IDs (account_id, campaign_id, ad_group_id, ad_id) from ad_performance_daily_report for all available records
Lookup ad titles (ad names) in ad_history for each ad_id referenced in ad_performance_daily_report, ensuring status and other required ad fields are present
Lookup ad group status and other ad group details in ad_group_history for each ad_group_id referenced in ad_performance_daily_report
Lookup campaign information in campaign_history for each campaign_id referenced in ad_performance_daily_report
Lookup account last modified time and other account details in account_history by matching customer_id from campaign_history to id in account_history
Filter to only complete records where impressions, language, ad title, ad group status, campaign information, and account last modified time are all available

Aggregate the filtered records by language and ad group status to compute the count of records and total impressions for each combination, along with including ad title, campaign information, and account last modified time in the result set
ads.sql:
WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT 
    ad_performance_daily_report.impressions,
    ad_performance_daily_report.language,
    ad_group_history.status,
    ad_history.title,
    campaign_history.budget,
    account_history.last_modified_time
  FROM ad_performance_daily_report
  LEFT JOIN ad_group_history ON ad_performance_daily_report.ad_group_id = ad_group_history.id
  LEFT JOIN ad_history ON ad_performance_daily_report.ad_id = ad_history.id
  LEFT JOIN campaign_history ON ad_performance_daily_report.campaign_id = campaign_history.id
  LEFT JOIN account_history ON ad_performance_daily_report.account_id = account_history.id
  WHERE ad_performance_daily_report.impressions IS NOT NULL
    AND ad_performance_daily_report.language IS NOT NULL
    AND ad_group_history.status IS NOT NULL
    AND ad_history.title IS NOT NULL
    AND campaign_history.budget IS NOT NULL
    AND account_history.last_modified_time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  language,
  status,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(CAST(impressions AS INTEGER)) as total
FROM base_data
GROUP BY language, status

query: Retrieve spend and device_os by date, account_id, campaign_id, and ad_group_id from ad_group_performance_daily_report
Retrieve the latest Ad Group Status for each ad_group_id from ad_group_history
Retrieve the Campaign Type (advertising_channel_type) and customer_id for each campaign_id from campaign_history
Retrieve account information for each account_id from account_history where account_history.id matches campaign_history.customer_id

Join ad_group_performance_daily_report with ad_group_history, campaign_history, and account_history on the appropriate keys to enrich each performance record with Ad Group Status, Campaign Type, and account information
Group the joined records by device_os, Ad Group Status, and Campaign Type and calculate total spend and count of records for each unique combination
ads.sql:
WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT 
    ad_group_performance_daily_report.spend,
    ad_group_performance_daily_report.device_os,
    ad_group_history.status,
    campaign_history.name,
    campaign_history.type,
    account_history.last_modified_time
  FROM ad_group_performance_daily_report

query: Retrieve item weights and their units from item_summary
Retrieve brand information for each item from item_dimension
Retrieve manufacturer information for each item from item_dimension
Determine the standardized weight unit category (Pounds, Kilograms, Grams, or Other) for each item based on its weight unit
Aggregate the count of products and total weight for each brand-manufacturer-weight unit category combination
business.sql:
WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT 
    item_summary.brand,
    item_summary.manufacturer,
    item_dimension.item_weight_unit,
    item_dimension.item_weight_value,
    CASE
      WHEN item_dimension.item_weight_unit = 'pounds' THEN 'Weight in Pounds'
      WHEN item_dimension.item_weight_unit = 'kilograms' THEN 'Weight in Kilograms'
      WHEN item_dimension.item_weight_unit = 'grams' THEN 'Weight in Grams'
      ELSE 'Other Unit'
    END as weight_category
  FROM item_summary
  LEFT JOIN item_dimension ON item_summary.asin = item_dimension.asin
  WHERE item_summary.brand IS NOT NULL
    AND item_dimension.item_weight_unit IS NOT NULL
    AND item_dimension.item_weight_value IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  brand,
  manufacturer,
  weight_category,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(CAST(item_weight_value AS DOUBLE)) as total
FROM base_data
GROUP BY brand, manufacturer, weight_category

query: Retrieve all orders that have associated promotion IDs from the Amazon Selling Partner data
Identify unshipped order items within the filtered set of orders that have promotion IDs
Determine the product classification (Base Product, Variation Parent, Product Bundle, or Other) for each unshipped order item
Count the number of order items in each product classification category among the unshipped items with promotion IDs
Calculate the total number of unshipped units/items in each product classification category among the unshipped items with promotion IDs
business.sql:
WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT 
    order_item_promotion_id.order_item_id,
    int_amazon_selling_partner__item.item_classification,
    orders.number_of_items_unshipped,
    CASE
      WHEN int_amazon_selling_partner__item.item_classification = 'BASE_PRODUCT' THEN 'Base Product'
      WHEN int_amazon_selling_partner__item.item_classification = 'VARIATION_PARENT' THEN 'Variation Parent'
      WHEN int_amazon_selling_partner__item.item_classification = 'PRODUCT_BUNDLE' THEN 'Product Bundle'
      ELSE 'Other Classification'
    END as classification_category
  FROM order_item
  LEFT JOIN order_item_promotion_id ON order_item.amazon_order_id = order_item_promotion_id.amazon_order_id 
    AND order_item.order_item_id = order_item_promotion_id.order_item_id
  LEFT JOIN int_amazon_selling_partner__item ON order_item.asin = int_amazon_selling_partner__item.asin
  LEFT JOIN orders ON order_item.amazon_order_id = orders.amazon_order_id
  WHERE order_item_promotion_id.order_item_id IS NOT NULL
    AND int_amazon_selling_partner__item.item_classification IS NOT NULL
    AND orders.number_of_items_unshipped IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  classification_category,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(CAST(number_of_items_unshipped AS INTEGER)) as total
FROM base_data
GROUP BY classification_category

query: Retrieve all opportunity records from the opportunity table with their id, type, stage, value, and campaign_id fields

WITH ranked_data AS (
  SELECT 
    log.event,
    destination.created_at,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY log.message_event ORDER BY destination.created_at DESC) as row_num
  FROM connection
  LEFT JOIN log ON connection.connection_id = log.connection_id
  LEFT JOIN destination ON connection.destination_id = destination.id
  WHERE log.event IS NOT NULL
    AND destination.created_at IS NOT NULL
)

  event,

FROM ranked_data
WHERE row_num <= 10

    issue.state,
    issue.locked,

    COALESCE(CAST(int_github__pull_request_times.hours_request_review_to_first_review AS DOUBLE), 0.0) as hours_to_first_review_clean,
